messages:
Jordan Park: customer (tenant t-acme-92) is asking for compliance evidence — they claim users were deprovisioned via SSO on 2026-03-12 but our audit shows no deprov entries. they need exports for legal. can someone triage? :eyes:

Miguel Ortega: on it. can you paste the relevant logs or timestamp window? i can start a pull for their tenant export. :mag_right:

Jordan Park: logs attached below (direct excerpt):
```
2026-03-12T10:11:59Z SAML: assertion validation failed user=alice@acme.com relay_state=abc123 status=401 invalid_signature
2026-03-12T10:12:03Z INFO scim: deprov request user=alice@acme.com tenant=t-acme-92 req_id=req-9a7
2026-03-12T10:12:03Z ERROR kms: unwrap failed key_id=projects/t-acme-92/keys/k-xyz error=KMS_UNWRAP_FAILED code=403
2026-03-12T10:12:04Z WARN audit: write failed audit_id=authz-123 err=500 storage=retention-mgr
```

Sam Rivera: hm — KMS_UNWRAP_FAILED (403) + audit write 500 in same window. looks like HSM/unwrap transient around 10:12. i'll check HSM metrics and unwrap latency graphs for that minute.

Priya Singh: important for legal — what retention window was applied? if the audit write failed it might not have been persisted. we need: 1) canonical export of what landed in S3 for tenant t-acme-92, 2) HSM unwrap error timeline, 3) an audit-backfill plan if events are missing.

Nora Kim: repro steps to reproduce quickly for infra:
1) run SCIM deprov simulator against tenant (use test token)
2) check scim-worker logs and audit writer for write status
3) if kms unwrap fails, capture unwrap stack + hsm syscall logs

command: 
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \\n  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/t-acme-92/scim/Users -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "externalId":"alice@acme.com", "active":false}'
```

Alex Patel: also double-check RBAC/role mapping for alice@acme.com — if an orphaned service account had higher privileges, audit writer path might have taken a different queue (we had a sparse-case where audit writes for service accounts used a separate pipeline that didn't retry on storage 500). query suggestion: 
```sql
SELECT ts, event_type, actor, dest FROM deprov_events WHERE tenant='t-acme-92' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100;
```

Jordan Park: customer needs export + signed attestation by EOD Friday. is backfill possible? they want an explanation for regulators.

Sam Rivera: i can spin up the backfill job for that tenant. estimate 2-3 hours to run and verify. will need sec signoff for attestation if we re-ingest events.

Priya Singh: i can sign attestation once we confirm backfill results. next steps: sam queue backfill, miguel hand the initial S3 export & retention_policy docs, alex verify RBAC mapping and whether any service accounts bypassed main audit pipeline. i'll compile explanation text for legal. :lock:

sec-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-unwrap-and-audit-backfill (steps + owner checklist)

Miguel Ortega: started tenant export job (job id export-2170). ETA ~30m for raw objects. i'll post link when ready.

Nora Kim: flagged for oncall — i'll watch the backfill and hsm metrics. ping me if you need traces. :eyes:

Jordan Park: thanks all — i'll update customer with temporary workaround (export + promise of backfill + attestation) and follow up after verifying results.

Alex Patel: FYI added DB query to a temp dashboard for t-acme-92 to watch new entries during backfill.

Sam Rivera: backfill queued at 2026-03-12T14:05:00Z, job id backfill-8721. will update when complete.

Priya Singh: noting compliance timeline in case legal requests chain-of-custody: need hashes of exported objects and signed HSM logs.

Jordan Park: copy — i'll collect and send to customer once we have export link and backfill confirmation. :thumbsup:
